title: Write a tutorial for your team
summary: Turn a procedure of your team into a guided tutorial: write the steps, say when each one is done, and publish it.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body:
A tutorial is a list of steps. Each step says what to do, can **highlight** something on the page, offers **Fill** buttons for the values to type, and knows when it is **done**: a click on Next, something appearing, a page opening, or IRIS saving something.

You will write a short one and publish it.

steps.title: Open Settings -> Tutorials
steps.body: Tutorials are managed under **Settings -> Tutorials**. The built-in ones can be edited too: your version replaces the shipped one for everyone.

steps.title: Name it
steps.body: Give it a title and a one-line summary: they are what your team sees in the list.

fills.label: Summary
fills.value: Open a case for a reported phishing mail and add the sender as an IOC.

steps.title: Write the step
steps.body: Give the step a title and say what to do: **bold** and `code` work. Under **Highlight**, name what to point at: a `data-tour` name such as `case-new`, or a CSS selector such as `#case_name`.

fills.label: What to do
fills.value: On the case queue, click **Open a case**.

steps.title: Say when it is done
steps.body: **Done when** decides when the panel moves on. **Something appears on the page** waits for an element (here `case-form`, the new-case form). **IRIS saves something** waits for a request and can capture a value from its reply, for example `case_id` as `caseId`, for the later steps.

steps.title: Publish and save
steps.body: Tick **Published** so your team sees it under Tutorials, then click **Save**.

steps.title: Try it, then share it
steps.body: **Try it** runs the tutorial as you see it in the editor, saved or not, without counting as completed. It replaces this tutorial in the panel, so click it after **Finish**. **Export** saves the tutorial as a file another IRIS-NG server can **Import**.
